svg.title: Outbound routes and Arkadia homebound options, with intermediate stops
svg.desc: One connected schematic, not to scale. Read each corridor leg downward in its listed direction; the 7E return leg is drawn upward on the left after a direction switch, with arrowheads marking travel direction. Hollow circles are stops; larger rings are boarding, transfer or alighting points. The corridor 4 leg uses Galunggung via Saharjo; 5M uses the via Cikini pattern. The corridor 4 leg uses Galunggung via Saharjo; 5M uses the via Cikini pattern. Other patterns may skip stops. The road by the venue is drawn between the two 7E directions: the pedestrian bridge between the Mujair and Phe Tower stops crosses it, the venue sits beside Phe Tower Kebagusan, and Jln. Gabus Raya (far side) and Baung (venue side) are both farther along toward Kampung Rambutan, and the Flyover Raya Bogor direction switch stays inside the paid area with no new fare (all firsthand 18 Nov 2026).

Rings = boarding / transfer / get off · small circles = intermediate stops · arrowheads = travel direction · dashed = walk or a direction switch
Corridor legs show the listed direction only - do not reverse them. The drawn 7E return leg is the actual Ragunan-bound pattern.
The 7E Flyover Raya Bogor switch was a candidate from GTFS-derived listings - firsthand 18 Nov 2026 it stays inside the paid area, no new fare.
Firsthand 18 Nov 2026: the venue sits beside the Phe Tower Kebagusan stop; the pedestrian bridge is between the Mujair and
Phe Tower stops; Jln. Gabus Raya (far side) and Baung (venue side) are both farther along toward Kampung Rambutan.
4 and 4D share their first ten stops (same stop IDs): one drawn column. 4D then branches right to Rasuna Said (outbound only); that list is from jaGOdetabek and halte.id, not GTFS.
